title: Godot 4.5.2 fails to compile with AccessKit 0.21.2, 0.21.1, 0.18.0
body:
### Tested versions

As title says, compiling with Godot 4.5.2 fails with AccessKit v0.21.2, v0.21.1, and v0.18.0.  Godot 4.6.1 compiles fine with v0.18.0 but fails with v0.21.2 and v0.21.1 for different reasons than 4.5.2 fails.

[I opened an issue on Godot's AccessKit repo as well that contains a file with the errors.](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-accesskit-c-static/issues/6)

### System information

MacOS, Linux, Windows compiling on Fedora 43

### Issue description

In Godot 4.5.2, there are various errors but, [for example, this line passes two arguments to `accesskit_custom_action_new`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6ce3de25aa58466e14ef354703ba8d9791a417da/drivers/accesskit/accessibility_driver_accesskit.cpp#L957) but it seems to [only take one in the AccessKit repo](https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit-c/blob/72460cd52d1b24492393cdf54a6f19d2fd63e258/include/accesskit.h#L2190) and the downloaded zip from Godot's AccessKit repo.

This is just one of many errors that it seems to produce.  The full list is in the error.txt in the linked issue.

In Godot 4.6.1, [it passes one argument](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/14d19694e0c88a3f9e82d899a0400f27a24c176e/drivers/accesskit/accessibility_driver_accesskit.cpp#L977) which works fine in AccessKit 0.18.0.  I'm not sure why this changed or how the newer Godot release of 4.5.2 works with AccessKit now.

### Steps to reproduce

- Download AccessKit 0.21.2 from Godot's repo for AccessKit
- Compile 4.5.2 on Linux, cross-compile OSX, cross-compile Windows with MinGW
- Should fail to compile

N/A
